title: Function-signature sentinel + lightweight shadow verifier for staged rollouts
creator: Samir Patel
description: Build a lightweight runtime component ("function-signature sentinel") and a shadow-verifier service to detect function-call and structured-output incompatibilities during canary/A-B and shadow traffic rollouts. The goal is to catch breaking changes to function names, argument shapes, and return schema drift early without full offline evals, expose concise per-rollout scoring, and provide deterministic auto-rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel runs as a sidecar/agent in canary nodes and emits diffs for any function-call signature changes (name, arg count, arg types as normalized tags)
Shadow-verifier accepts sampled shadow requests and performs fuzzy-arg-matching to tolerate benign reorderings (configurable match thresholds)
Rollout dashboard exposes per-function mismatch rate, schema-diff histogram, and latency delta (p50/p95) compared to baseline model
Auto-rollback rule: >2% high-severity signature mismatches OR >5% structured-output parsing failures within 30m window triggers orchestrated unwind with audit log

End-to-end integration test that simulates: new model with renamed arg, new optional field, removed required field and confirms sentinel flags correct severities and rollback occurs when threshold met
